listing.name: Yakuza: Dead Souls — YakuzaDeadSoulsRecompiled (canersaka)
listing.summary: The project reaches the intro, title and New Game opening into gameplay. A full playthrough is not claimed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American BLUS30826 version 1.00 disc files, including ELF, shader PRX, SPU and assets. Firmware is not required.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the source instructions for local function discovery, PPU/PRX/SPU translation and building. Generated code is excluded from the distributed source.

warnings: The project reaches the intro, title and New Game opening into gameplay. A full playthrough is not claimed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
